levels.name: Interoperate
levels.question: Can I connect?
levels.description: Open interfaces connect agents, tools and services across models, vendors and ecosystems.

levels.name: Understand
levels.question: Can we understand each other?
levels.description: Shared semantics let systems exchange meaning, context and intent—not just messages.

levels.name: Trust
levels.question: Can I rely on you?

levels.name: Govern
levels.question: Who is ultimately in control?
levels.description: People and institutions retain authority over knowledge, identity, policies, skills, memory and decisions.
